text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-President Ben Ali chaired a cabinet meeting on foreign investment. Recommends better coordination between government's agencies involved in foreign investment issues.
-Algerian Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia arrived in Tunis on Friday for a three-day visit. President Ben Ali instructed Prime Minister Hamed Karoui to boost cooperation with Algeria.
- Karoui briefed the president on his talks in Jordan.
- U.N.'s Food and Agriculture Organisation to help Tunisia assess fishing resources.
-A cabinet meeting recommends boosting Tunisian trade missions abroad.
- Parliament adopts the Equipment Ministry 1997 budget.
-Trade Minister Mondher Zenaidi told parliament the government will reinforce measures to control quality of imported products.
